patch_list: Keeps Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics off for good: the app ships them off and turns them on by itself after it starts. Scores, news and notifications aren't touched.

Hides the banners, the native ads, the full-screen ads and the rewarded video ads, and never starts the ad networks (Google AdMob with AppLovin, Meta, Pangle, Liftoff and DT Exchange). The subscription and any paid feature aren't touched.
